What subscription plans are available for factories on Maker's Row?
Maker’s Row offers four main subscription plans for factories:
Free Plan:
Standard Plan:
Priced at $499 per month, offering enhanced directory placement, unlimited messaging, bidding, factory search, brand building and access to other project management tools.
Preferred Plan:
Priced at $1499 per month, offering everything in the standard plan along with the additional services such as mid tier ranking access, social media branding, and priority support.
Premium Plan:

Priced at $2999 per month, offering everything in the preferred plan along with the additional services such as higher ranking access, social media branding, dedicated account management and priority support.
Is there a free trial available for any plan for factories?
Yes, Maker’s Row offers a 5-day free trial (based on the request) for the Paid Plans, allowing factories to explore all the features before committing to a subscription.
Can factories upgrade or downgrade their subscription plans at any time?
Yes, factories can upgrade or downgrade their subscription plans at any time. Changes will take effect at the start of the next billing cycle.
